name: Social Bar
summary: Shopify app from Effective Apps that adds a bar of social media icons and share buttons to storefront pages, covering more than 80 platforms, with a per-platform Follow Us bar, shape and colour options, an animation, a one-click hide for shoppers and a click counter. Built for Shopify, on the App Store since April 2020.
best_for: Shopify merchants who want branded social icons and a WhatsApp chat button on product pages without touching theme code, and who will use the built-in click counter to check whether anyone taps them
skip_if: your theme already places social links where you need them, you are unwilling to pay a recurring fee for a display element, or you are looking for real social proof such as reviews, user content or engagement analytics rather than a row of icons
honest_knock: This is a styling subscription, and the listing's own framing oversells it: social icons and share buttons build no trust on their own, and 'boost sales with social proof' is a claim the app has no way to support. The free plan is free in a way that will not help you, since it is restricted to development and partner stores, so any live store is on $4.99 a month or $41.88 a year for something most themes already do in the footer. The 5.0 average deserves reading rather than trusting: two of the three reviews on the listing were written after 11 and 13 minutes of use and praise setup rather than results, while the one longer-running reviewer reports that icon placement is limited and the app is tricky to figure out at first. And more than 80 platform options mainly tempts you to advertise accounts you no longer maintain.

pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-10-19 on apps.shopify.com/sticky-social-media-icons-bar; first read 2026-09-18) Two plans, and the free one is not the one you will be on. Development is free but the listing limits it explicitly to development and partner stores, with billing activated on upgrade — so a real storefront does not run on it. The Monthly Plan is $4.99 a month, or $41.88 a year which the listing presents as a 30 percent saving, after a 7-day free trial. All charges are billed in USD and recurring charges are invoiced every 30 days. The app has been on the App Store since 27 April 2020 and carries Shopify's Built for Shopify badge.
